source='''def transform(grid):
    colors = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0})
    objects = []
    for color in colors:
        cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == color]
        r0, c0 = min(r for r, c in cells), min(c for r, c in cells)
        shape = [[0] * (max(c for r, c in cells)-c0+1) for _ in range(max(r for r, c in cells)-r0+1)]
        for r, c in cells:
            shape[r-r0][c-c0] = color
        objects.append((r0, c0, shape))
    horizontal = max(c for r, c, shape in objects)-min(c for r, c, shape in objects) >= max(r for r, c, shape in objects)-min(r for r, c, shape in objects)
    if horizontal:
        objects.sort(key=lambda obj: obj[1])
        out = [[0] * (3*len(objects)) for _ in range(3)]
        for i, (r0, c0, shape) in enumerate(objects):
            for r, row in enumerate(shape):
                for c, value in enumerate(row):
                    out[r][3*i+c] = value
    else:
        objects.sort(key=lambda obj: obj[0])
        out = [[0] * 3 for _ in range(3*len(objects))]
        for i, (r0, c0, shape) in enumerate(objects):
            for r, row in enumerate(shape):
                for c, value in enumerate(row):
                    out[3*i+r][c] = value
    return out
'''
